item.title: About
item.description: This website is a sincere effort of one introvert on a mission to help humans create simple systems that make us happy and productive. What’s the deal here My name is Ondrej. I’m a 27-year-old entrepreneur, designer, and indie writer living in Prague. Also generalist, introvert, and self-learner. Big fan of systems and games. And this is my digital garage with the doors kept open. I love deconstructing complex ideas into easy-to-use methods and tools.
